clientID.description: Client identifier sent to the broker. If empty, Grafana prefixes a random number with grafana_.

enableSecureSocksProxy.description: Route the broker connection through Private Data Source Connect (PDC). Available when Grafana enables the secure SOCKS proxy. Use TCP or TLS with PDC.

keepAlive.description: TCP keep-alive interval for the PDC proxy connection, in seconds. The SDK drops fractional seconds. Provisioning only.

secureSocksProxyUsername.description: SOCKS username for PDC. Defaults to the data source UID. Provisioning only.

timeout.description: Time to wait for the PDC proxy connection, in seconds. The SDK drops fractional seconds. Provisioning only.

tlsAuth.description: Show the client certificate and private key inputs for mutual TLS.

tlsAuthWithCACert.description: Show the CA certificate input for verifying the broker.

tlsSkipVerify.description: Skip verification of the broker certificate chain and host name for TLS connections.

uri.description: MQTT broker URI. Include the port for direct TCP or TLS, for example tcp://localhost:1883 or tls://broker.example.com:8883. Use ws:// or wss:// with the broker's WebSocket path, or unix:///path/to/socket for a local Unix domain socket. The URI is public. Use jsonData.username and secureJsonData.password for credentials. A username or password in the URI overrides its corresponding setting.

username.description: Username sent to the broker. Leave empty for anonymous or certificate-only authentication.

secureValues.description: Optional broker password. The MQTT client sends a password only when it has a username from jsonData.username or the broker URI. A password in the URI overrides this value.
PEM-encoded CA certificates used in place of the system trust roots to verify the broker.
PEM-encoded client certificate presented to the broker for mutual TLS. Supply the matching private key.
PEM-encoded private key for the client certificate presented to the broker.
SOCKS password for PDC. Provisioning only.
